papers.title: SAFER: Navigating the Exploration-Exploitation Dilemma in World-Model-Based Planning for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: An autonomous vehicle must foresee the consequences of its actions, especially in the rare, time-critical situations where crashes happen. A world model offers this foresight, but only within the coverage of its training data, which poses an exploration-exploitation dilemma. Within this coverage a planner can hardly improve on the data, and beyond it the model's errors mislead it. Logs of competent driving rarely contain the failures that would widen the coverage, and agents that learn from interaction gain them only by failing themselves, without being shown what to do instead. We propose SAFER, a framework that learns offline from failures that others make, judged by an expert, and keeps learning online from its own driving. Offline, partially trained agents and scripted, recoverable perturbations Stage failures in simulation, and an expert Annotates every visited state with its action and value, so that much of what the planner explores is covered before it drives. In planning, a chunked latent world model Foresees the consequences fast enough for real-time use, and a risk-aware sampling-based planner Evaluates candidate maneuvers by their return minus a bounded collision penalty. Online, a loop continuously Refines the model wherever this driving leaves the coverage of the offline data. In closed-loop evaluation against the compared methods, SAFER reaches the highest route completion and reward per step on the CARLA Leaderboard routes, 0.95 and 0.77 from a privileged bird's-eye view, and the highest episode reward in MetaDrive, 53.4 in regular and 49.0 in safety-critical traffic. Project page: https://ys-qu.github.io/safer-website.
papers.summary_cn: 论文研究依赖世界模型进行自动驾驶规划时的探索—利用两难：在训练数据覆盖范围内规划难以超越示范，超出范围后模型误差又会使规划器偏好错误动作。SAFER通过“阶段化失败并由专家标注”扩展离线覆盖范围，再用分块潜在世界模型预测候选动作序列的未来，并结合奖励、价值、持续性和碰撞风险进行MPPI规划。其风险头以累积安全事件为目标，并加入“更强制动不应增加风险预测”的单调性约束；在线阶段则利用规划器自身的驾驶数据联合微调动力学、奖励评分器和风险头，同时冻结编码器、行为先验和值集成，并用EMA参数稳定规划目标。CARLA和MetaDrive的闭环实验表明，风险惩罚、在线适应和针对覆盖薄弱场景的数据飞轮均能改善安全性和整体表现；SAFER在CARLA中取得0.95路线完成率、0.80驾驶分数和0.77单位步奖励，在MetaDrive常规及安全关键交通中分别取得53.4和49.0的回合奖励。
papers.contribution_cn: 提出了世界模型规划中模型覆盖范围、优化器偏差与失败经验之间的探索—利用两难及相应的模型误差和遗憾形式化分析；提出利用较弱策略和可恢复脚本扰动在仿真中阶段化失败、再由专家为每个状态提供动作和值标签的数据构建方法；设计了可在一次前向传播中预测整段未来的分块潜在世界模型，并加入物理分解奖励、持续性、价值集成和行为克隆动作先验；提出带碰撞风险头的风险感知MPPI规划器，以预测回报减去有界风险惩罚选择动作；提出在线适应机制，联合更新动力学、奖励评分器和风险头，并用EMA评分目标保持规划稳定；通过CARLA和MetaDrive的闭环消融、基线比较、风险预测分析和数据飞轮实验验证各组成部分的作用。
papers.relevance_cn: 论文与视频生成和视频扩散的直接关系较弱，核心任务是自动驾驶世界模型规划而非像素级视频生成。但其方法与研究重点在技术上高度相关：它使用动作条件的潜在世界模型预测未来状态，采用带因果掩码的Transformer在一次前向传播中生成整段、具有自回归语义的未来潜变量；通过固定长度历史和动作块进行滚动规划，属于面向闭环控制的短时长、流式式预测；分块预测避免逐步递归推演，降低了实时规划成本；MPPI通过缓存上一时刻规划分布并结合行为先验进行采样，体现了候选复用和规划加速；在线闭环适应使模型能够从自身访问的新状态持续扩展覆盖范围。这些设计可为动作条件视频世界模型、因果长视频预测、实时生成和缓存复用提供可借鉴的系统思路。
papers.limitations_cn: 实验主要在CARLA和MetaDrive仿真器中进行，且CARLA使用特权鸟瞰图和自车状态输入，不能直接证明真实视觉传感器或现实道路上的效果。离线失败数据依赖仿真中的较弱策略、动作噪声和脚本化且可恢复的扰动，可能无法覆盖真实驾驶中的全部危险情形。在线适应需要在目标环境中持续收集大量交互数据；论文中CARLA使用了10^6个环境步，MetaDrive也在训练场景上进行适应，因此其部署成本和对未适应环境的泛化能力有限。模型规划视野为16步、即1.6秒，较长期后果主要依赖价值头外推。规划使用135个候选动作块并以10 Hz运行，计算效率虽满足论文所述仿真设置，但真实车辆部署的资源需求和延迟鲁棒性论文未明确说明。SAFER在CARLA的驾驶分数低于DreamerV3，且行人碰撞率高于部分基线；数据飞轮提高安全性但使系统更加谨慎、阻塞率上升。对真实世界、不同传感器模态、极端不可恢复失败以及大规模长时视频生成质量的局限，论文未明确说明。
papers.abstract_cn: 自动驾驶车辆必须预见其行动的后果，尤其是在发生碰撞的罕见且时间紧迫的情形中。世界模型能够提供这种预见能力，但其能力仅限于训练数据的覆盖范围，这带来了探索与利用的两难。在覆盖范围内，规划器几乎无法超越数据本身；而一旦超出覆盖范围，模型误差就会误导规划器。高水平驾驶日志很少包含能够扩展覆盖范围的失败，而通过交互学习的智能体只有亲自失败才能获得这些经验，却不会被告知应当如何替代。我们提出 SAFER，一种离线学习他人造成的失败并由专家评判、同时持续在线学习自身驾驶经验的框架。离线阶段，部分训练的智能体和脚本化的、可恢复的扰动在仿真中促成失败，专家为每个访问状态标注应采取的动作及其价值，从而使规划器探索的大部分情形在实际驾驶前就已经被覆盖。在规划阶段，分块潜在世界模型快速预见后果，以满足实时使用需求；风险感知的基于采样的规划器则按照回报减去有界碰撞惩罚来评估候选机动。在在线阶段，一个闭环持续地在驾驶超出离线数据覆盖范围的地方细化模型。在针对比较方法的闭环评估中，SAFER 在 CARLA Leaderboard 路线上取得了最高的路线完成率和单位步奖励，从特权鸟瞰视角看分别达到 0.95 和 0.77；在 MetaDrive 中，它在常规交通和安全关键交通下分别以 53.4 和 49.0 的成绩取得最高回合奖励。项目主页：https://ys-qu.github.io/safer-website。

papers.title: A Unified Control Framework, Mathematical Model, and Five-layer Closed-loop Case Study for Embodied Intelligence Control Systems
papers.abstract: Embodied intelligence holds that an agent develops cognition and behavior through real-time body-environment interaction, so its control system must tightly couple perception, decision making, learning, optimization, constraints, and physical execution. This report asks whether a unified framework exists, how its mathematical models unify, and how the framework is realized computably. Four conclusions emerge. (1) No single framework is accepted, but the field converges on a common skeleton: from operational-space and whole-body control to MPC, reinforcement learning, active inference, and diffusion/flow policies, all reduce to constrained sequential decision making on the configuration manifold. (2) Two languages describe it-deterministic optimal control (Euler-Lagrange plus constrained OCP, reduced in real time to a QP) and probabilistic inference (MDP/POMDP plus free-energy minimization)-rigorously bridged by control as inference and KL/path-integral control. (3) Engineering unification is already achieved by constrained optimization; the new frontier is cross-morphology, cross-task shared representation. (4) The hardest gap is provable stability and safety, the entry point for spectral, geometric, differentiable-optimization, and safe-learning methods. A single-link manipulator then runs through all five layers: L4 parses the instruction into a reference, L3 identifies a Koopman lifted linear world model, L2 solves a receding constrained QP, L1 adds torque saturation and a CBF, and L0 is the true nonlinear plant. Closed-loop tracking RMSE is 0.0218 rad with all constraints satisfied and a world-model error near 5 x 10^-6 rad, reported with curves and a 3D animation.
papers.summary_cn: 论文提出具身智能控制系统的五层统一架构：L4认知与任务、L3表示与学习、L2优化与推理、L1约束与接触、L0物理与动力学。作者认为，操作空间控制、全身控制、MPC、强化学习、主动推理以及扩散/流策略在更高层次上都可视为配置流形上的约束序贯决策，并可由确定性最优控制和概率推理两种数学语言描述，再通过控制即推理等方法连接。论文重点强调以约束优化实现工程统一，同时指出跨形态共享表示、稳定性证明和安全保证仍是关键问题。单连杆机械臂实验使用Koopman世界模型、递推MPC、力矩限制和CBF，在50 Hz闭环仿真中取得0.0218弧度跟踪RMSE，验证了五层信息流，但尚未证明其对复杂机器人和真实环境的泛化能力。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 提出一个包含认知、表示学习、优化推理、安全约束和物理执行的五层具身智能控制架构，并定义层间输入输出接口。 2. 将欧拉–拉格朗日动力学、约束最优控制/QP、MDP/POMDP、自由能最小化、控制即推理和KL/路径积分控制置于统一数学骨架中。 3. 系统比较操作空间控制、逆动力学、HQP、MPC、DDP/iLQR、几何控制、PCH、CLF-CBF-QP、强化学习、主动推理、扩散/流策略和世界模型等方法族。 4. 构建可复现的五层闭环案例：由语言指令生成参考轨迹，利用Koopman提升模型进行MPC，并通过力矩饱和和CBF实施安全约束。 5. 通过固定种子、RK4真实非线性对象、离线模型识别和暖启动SLSQP，报告了世界模型预测误差、闭环跟踪误差及约束满足情况。 6. 总结了安全学习、物理融合世界模型、跨形态表示、可微优化和生成策略稳定性等研究方向。
papers.relevance_cn: 论文与研究重点具有直接但偏控制框架层面的关系。它明确讨论了世界模型、Koopman动力学、扩散/流策略、强化学习和实时MPC，并将它们放入感知—决策—动作闭环中。其五层架构尤其适用于分析动作条件视觉世界模型和闭环仿真：L3负责学习状态—动作表示及世界模型，L2根据任务参考和模型滚动优化动作，L1负责安全过滤，L0执行真实动力学并反馈状态。论文还涉及实时生成和推理约束，强调采样周期内的确定性延迟、模型预测误差、规划时域和暖启动。不过，论文的实验是单自由度机械臂的低维状态控制，不是视频生成或视觉条件生成；没有研究自回归视频生成、因果/流式长视频生成、稀疏注意力、缓存复用或扩散模型蒸馏。因此，它更适合作为动作条件世界模型和安全闭环控制的概念与数学背景，而不是视频生成算法论文。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文明确指出，案例仅覆盖单连杆、单自由度系统，不包含多刚体耦合、真实接触摩擦或高维感知；实验主要是固定种子下的仿真，未在真实机器人硬件上验证。Koopman模型采用有限维提升，无法完整表示真实非线性，多步开环预测会累积误差。有限预测时域、代价权重和执行器饱和会造成跟踪误差。模型训练和规划均为离线流程，未实现在线适应。训练分布之外的泛化、学习模块的端到端稳定性证明、复杂环境中的安全性以及跨形态迁移仍未解决。论文也指出，具身智能系统的实时推理、仿真到现实差距、数据需求、可解释性和认证仍是开放问题。对于视频生成、长视频生成、流式生成、稀疏注意力、缓存复用和蒸馏，论文未提供实验或专门分析。
papers.abstract_cn: 具身智能认为，智能体通过与身体和环境的实时交互发展认知与行为，因此其控制系统必须紧密耦合感知、决策、学习、优化、约束和物理执行。本报告探讨是否存在统一框架、其数学模型如何统一，以及该框架如何以可计算的方式实现。研究得出四点结论：（1）目前尚无单一框架获得普遍认可，但该领域正在趋向共同骨架：从操作空间控制和全身控制，到模型预测控制、强化学习、主动推理以及扩散/流策略，都可以归结为配置流形上的约束序贯决策。（2）有两种语言描述这一框架：确定性最优控制（欧拉–拉格朗日方程加约束最优控制问题，并实时约化为二次规划）和概率推理（马尔可夫决策过程/部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程加自由能最小化）；控制即推理和KL/路径积分控制在理论上严谨地连接了二者。（3）工程层面的统一已经通过约束优化实现；新的前沿是跨形态、跨任务的共享表示。（4）最困难的缺口是可证明的稳定性与安全性，这也为谱方法、几何方法、可微优化和安全学习方法提供了切入点。随后，研究以单连杆机械臂贯穿展示五层架构：L4将指令解析为参考轨迹，L3识别Koopman提升线性世界模型，L2求解递推约束二次规划，L1加入力矩饱和和控制屏障函数，L0则是真实的非线性对象。闭环跟踪均方根误差为0.0218弧度，所有约束均得到满足，世界模型误差约为5×10⁻⁶弧度，并通过曲线和三维动画进行了报告。

papers.title: ActWorld-JEPA: Action-Conditioned JEPA World Models Meet Latent Planning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) enable future prediction in latent space without pixel reconstruction. However, latent predictive consistency alone does not establish the relative driving quality of candidate plans. We present ActWorld-JEPA, a joint-embedding formulation for candidate-based driving. Where Plan-Conditioned JEPA (PC-JEPA) uses global and step-wise trajectory intentions to guide recurrent latent prediction, then combines the predicted future with the current scene through gated cross-attention; Relational Residual Reranking ($R^3$) models agreement and discrepancy between plan and future representations under planning supervision, yielding bounded, gated residual corrections to the base planning scores. This formulation connects latent prediction to candidate selection using only observed context and proposed trajectories at inference. Benchmark-specific implementations report 94.1 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest, with the final selector calibrated using aggregate NAVTEST feedback, and 91.6 and 42.7 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest and navhard, respectively. The nuScenes evaluation reports a mean $L_2$ error of 1.20 m and a predicted collision rate of 0.76% over 1--6 s. This work provides an effective path from JEPA's predictive representations to driving decisions informed by anticipated consequences.
papers.summary_cn: 本文提出 ActWorld-JEPA，用于端到端自动驾驶中的候选轨迹选择。方法首先通过规划条件 JEPA 将每条候选轨迹编码为全局和逐步意图，并递归预测其对应的未来潜表示；随后利用门控交叉注意力融合当前场景与候选未来，再通过关系残差重排序模块建模规划意图与预测未来之间的一致性和差异性，对基础规划分数进行带置信度的有界修正。实验表明，该方法在 NAVSIM v1/v2 和 nuScenes 上取得较强结果，同时避免了像素级未来重建；在 RTX 4090 上完整前向推理速度为 21.33 FPS。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 提出 ActWorld-JEPA，将候选轨迹条件下的潜未来预测与轨迹选择统一起来，使规划决策能够利用候选动作可能产生的后果。2. 提出 PC-JEPA，通过全局及逐步轨迹意图调制初始潜状态并进行循环预测，再以门控交叉注意力融合当前场景和候选未来。3. 提出关系残差重排序（R³），同时利用规划方案与未来表示的特征一致性和差异性，以置信度门控的有界残差修正基础分数。4. 在 NAVSIM v1 navtest、NAVSIM v2 navtest/navhard 和 nuScenes 上进行了评估，报告了 94.1 PDMS、91.6/42.7 EPDMS，以及 1.20 米平均 L2 误差和 0.76% 平均预测碰撞率。
papers.relevance_cn: 与研究重点高度相关。该工作是动作条件视觉世界模型的一种潜空间实现：它以候选轨迹作为动作或规划条件，预测不同动作下的未来场景表示，并将预测后果用于候选轨迹重排序，形成从预测到决策的闭环式规划思想。它采用 JEPA 的潜表示预测而非像素重建，符合视频/视觉扩散之外的高效潜世界模型方向；循环 JEPA rollout 面向多步、最长 6 秒的未来规划，涉及因果式和长时域预测。其候选级并行推理、轻量级关系重排序以及无需解码图像的设计，有助于实时生成和高效规划；论文还报告了 21.33 FPS，但未涉及扩散蒸馏、稀疏注意力或显式缓存复用。需要注意的是，实验主要是 NAVSIM 的非反应式伪仿真和 nuScenes 开环规划，尚未充分验证真正的反应式闭环驾驶。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文明确指出，ActWorld-JEPA 依赖候选轨迹集合的覆盖范围，也依赖预测潜未来的可靠性；如果候选方案没有覆盖合适动作，或未来预测不准确，性能可能受限。作者将自适应候选生成、不确定性感知的候选评估，以及包含反应式交通参与者的闭环验证列为未来工作。实验主要基于 NAVSIM 的非反应式伪仿真和 nuScenes 开环规划，因此对真实闭环交互驾驶的有效性仍缺乏验证。模型参数量为 324.2M，虽然达到 21.33 FPS，但仍慢于 TransFuser 和 DiffusionDrive；该速度来自特定 RTX 4090 加速部署设置，不能直接代表其他硬件上的实时性能。论文未明确说明在更复杂环境、分布外场景或预测不确定性显著增大时的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_cn: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）能够在无需重建像素的情况下，在潜空间中预测未来。然而，仅保持潜变量预测的一致性，并不能确定候选规划方案之间相对的驾驶质量。我们提出 ActWorld-JEPA，一种面向候选方案驾驶的联合嵌入方法。其中，规划条件 JEPA（PC-JEPA）利用全局和逐步轨迹意图引导循环潜变量预测，随后通过门控交叉注意力将预测的未来与当前场景结合；关系残差重排序（R³）则在规划监督下建模规划方案与未来表示之间的一致性和差异性，从而对基础规划分数进行有界的门控残差修正。该方法仅在推理时使用观测到的上下文和提出的轨迹，就将潜变量预测与候选方案选择联系起来。针对不同基准的实现分别在 NAVSIM v1 navtest 上报告了 94.1 的 PDMS，在 NAVSIM v2 navtest 和 navhard 上报告了 91.6 和 42.7 的 EPDMS。nuScenes 评估显示，在 1—6 秒范围内，平均 L2 误差为 1.20 米，预测碰撞率为 0.76%。这项工作为利用 JEPA 的预测表示，根据预期后果辅助驾驶决策提供了一条有效路径。

papers.title: ResWAM: Learning What Changes, Not What Stays, for World-Action Models
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) augment vision-language-action policies (VLAs) with future prediction so that the policy can anticipate how its actions will affect the physical world. Existing WAMs supervise complete future observations. However, observations typically change little over an action chunk, so the future loss is dominated by copying static background content rather than learning task-relevant robot and object motion, limiting policy learning. Moreover, existing WAMs rely on large video generation models or separate world models, incurring heavy training and inference compute that hinders closed-loop deployment. To improve policy performance, we propose visual residual learning, supervising only the feature change from the current frame to the future frame in a frozen DINOv3 space. Compared with complete future features, this residual learning target yields a higher feature rank with richer and more diverse representations of scene changes, and spatially concentrates on the robot arm and manipulated objects rather than the background. To further improve computational efficiency, we present ResWAM, a residual world-action model with 2.3B parameters in total, including a lightweight 0.5B dual-branch DiT that jointly trains an action branch and a residual branch via conditional flow matching. Without robot pretraining (i.e., pretraining on external robot action trajectories beyond the benchmark demonstrations), ResWAM achieves top average success rates on LIBERO-Plus (81.1%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.8%), and RoboDojo (9.40% success, 13.41 score) at the lowest training (2.7-4.0 TFLOPs) and inference compute (1.0-1.4 TFLOPs), and leads real-robot Open, Put, and Stack (80.0% average, +10.0% over $π_{0.5}$) at 92.7 ms latency.
papers.summary_cn: World-action models (WAMs) augment vision-language-action policies (VLAs) with future prediction so that the policy can anticipate how its actions will affect the physical world.
papers.contribution_cn: To improve policy performance, we propose visual residual learning, supervising only the feature change from the current frame to the future frame in a frozen DINOv3 space.

papers.title: TelePhysica: Agentic Reconstruction of Physically Interactive Scenes
papers.abstract: Direct image-to-video diffusion models entangle pixel synthesis with implicit latent motion, precluding persistent 3D mechanical equilibrium, mid-rollout intervention, and counterfactual force control. Conversely, single-pass programmatic 3D reconstruction from an uncalibrated photograph leaves monocular depth and support clearance underconstrained, causing reconstructed scenes to interpenetrate or collapse under gravity. We present TelePhysica, a closed-loop framework that reconstructs an executable, multi-regime physical world from a single photograph to drive stateful 3D interaction and trajectory-grounded video synthesis. A vision-language coding agent synthesizes separable visual meshes and declarative physical models within a two-stage verification loop that pairs pixel-aligned silhouette critique with a zero-force gravitational equilibrium preflight. The verified world compiles into a unified solver coupling rigid bodies, articulated chains, co-dimensional cloth shells, and 3D tetrahedral elastodynamics, whose simulated rollouts condition pretrained video diffusion models through pixel-aligned structural streams. On a 100-scene single-image benchmark, closed-loop execution raises equilibrium-verified world recovery from $0\%$ in single-pass synthesis to $81\%$. Controlled constitutive ablations show over an order-of-magnitude larger localized corner displacement and out-of-plane pleating in finite-element cloth than in matched rigid-plate proxies. Conditioning video diffusion on simulated trajectories increases dynamic motion-mask overlap by $2{\times}\text{--}5{\times}$ and preserves motion direction under counterfactual force reversals where direct image-to-video models fail.

papers.contribution_cn: We present TelePhysica, a closed-loop framework that reconstructs an executable, multi-regime physical world from a single photograph to drive stateful 3D interaction and trajectory-grounded video synthesis.

papers.title: Cache or Denoise Less? Residual Reuse in a Flow-Matching World Action Model
papers.abstract: Flow-matching robot policies generate each action chunk through repeated network evaluations, one per denoising step. Cross-cycle caches such as C$^3$ache reuse computation from earlier replanning calls, but whether they beat simply taking fewer steps is unclear. We compare the two in Fast-WAM, a 6B-parameter world action model, on LIBERO-Goal. Two uncached steps keep the success of ten: on all 500 initial states they are non-inferior within two percentage points, for one checkpoint and noise seed. Under PyTorch's default compile mode, they also cut a replanning call on an RTX A6000 from 202 to 92 ms. This leaves little room for caching. A cache that keeps two fresh steps cannot be faster than two uncached steps: every call still encodes the images, runs the video expert and computes those two steps. Caching the first of two steps, refreshed every fourth call, saves at most 11--14% of a call by our cost model. Cached policies are also fragile. Their losses tracked the share of the flow path the cached steps cover: under Fast-WAM's current time shift, C$^3$ache's eight cached steps cover 80% of the path instead of 44%, and the cached policy succeeds on 63% of states against 95% uncached. Resampling the noise on every call cost caches covering 60% or more of the path 14--40 points. These results argue for fewer-step baselines and for testing reuse under the deployed sampler and noise settings. We release our evaluation harness, logs and a checklist.
papers.comment: Honorable Mention at the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Efficient Foundation Models for Real-Time Embodied AI (EEAI). Code and data available at https://github.com/gabhinav001/cache-or-denoise-less

papers.title: CoCode-World: Shared 3D Proxy Representation for Multi-Player World Models
papers.abstract: Multiplayer generative world models must produce observations that agree on shared entities despite different camera motions and occlusions. Explicit world representations provide spatial control, but precise modeling of individual game maps limits scene diversity, while shared geometry alone cannot ensure consistent appearance across views. We present CoCode-World, a shared 3D proxy framework that separates structural control from visual synthesis for two-player video generation. Programmable proxies specify scene layout, motion, and occlusion, while RGB references guide character and scene appearance. To coordinate visual details across players, we concatenate paired proxy videos, appearance references, and target views in a consistent spatial layout and generate both views jointly with a pretrained video model. This formulation uses the model's native attention for cross-view communication within a single generation branch, with LoRA adaptation learning proxy adherence and appearance correspondence from paired observations. We construct a two-player GTA~V dataset that pairs synchronized RGB observations with proxy videos derived from shared map geometry and game-engine state. Experiments demonstrate appearance transfer to characters and scene styles unseen during training, with improvements in video quality and cross-view player identity over the evaluated baseline. Ablations further examine how proxy construction and cross-view communication affect generation. Project page: https://iapple233.github.io/CCW/.

papers.title: PoCoAttn: Position-Content Collaborative Sparse Attention for Fast and High-Fidelity Video Generation
papers.abstract: Video diffusion transformers rely on 3D full attention over tens of thousands of spatiotemporal tokens, and its quadratic cost dominates inference latency. Sparse attention reduces this cost, but existing methods face a dilemma: static methods apply predefined masks and cannot capture input-dependent attention, whereas dynamic methods reconstruct the sparse mask repeatedly, paying online to rediscover positional structure that is largely stable across inputs. To this end, we propose PoCoAttn, a training-free sparse attention framework that separates input-stable from input-dependent attention and resolves the former offline and the latter online. PoCoAttn features: (1) A relative-offset analysis of 3D query-key pairs, which shows that video attention decomposes into an input-stable positional prior that carries most of the attention mass and a small content-dependent residual. (2) A position-content collaborative sparse attention mechanism, which retrieves positional keys from offline-calibrated tables, selects content keys online with a head-adaptive ratio between the two sources, and compensates for the discarded keys to approximate full attention. (3) A step-adaptive budget allocation algorithm, which models how early-step sparse attention errors are amplified along the denoising trajectory and derives the optimal sparsity budget per step. Extensive experiments across four video diffusion models and three tasks show that PoCoAttn consistently achieves a better speed-fidelity Pareto frontier than state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, improving PSNR by 1.9 to 5.0 dB over baselines and delivering up to 4.1$\times$ attention and 2.0$\times$ denoising speedups over dense FlashAttention-3 attention.

papers.title: JEPA4R: Embodied JEPA World Models with 4D Point Planning
papers.abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models predict future embeddings instead of pixels and plan in latent space. Two challenges remain: 2D images leave the metric geometry that manipulation acts on implicit and entangled with appearance, and what these models imagine stays hidden, as they are mostly judged in simulation by short-horizon latent planning. We present JEPA4R, a JEPA world model that observes single-depth-camera point clouds, predicts and plans in their latent space, and acts through a policy head on its frozen latents; we call this 4D point planning. A decoder on the frozen world model shows what it imagines as 4D point clouds, with a mean point error within 1.1 cm over 200 steps. Under the policy-learning protocols of OGBench and CortexBench, JEPA4R leads pixel JEPA models on OGBench Cube-Single, Cube-Double, Cube-Triple and Scene, and ranks first on MetaWorld and Adroit Relocate with 98.4% and 88.0%, above the runner-up, R3M, at 96.0% and 65.3%. Trained only in a digital twin, JEPA4R and its policy heads run zero-shot on the real arm with both a gripper and a dexterous hand.

papers.title: GameWM: Toward Next-Generation Video Games with Interaction-Centric World Models
papers.abstract: For more than half a century, video games have pursued better graphics, more natural interaction, and more engaging gameplay. Generative video models (VMs) now bear on all three. Neural networks already draw most of the pixels in shipped games, and recent world models let a lightweight game engine keep the world state while a VM turns the engine's coarse proxy video into final frames. These systems, however, treat the VM as a renderer that only restyles motion the engine has already authored, which leaves most of its generative capacity unused and limits the diversity a game can offer. We present GameWM, a design for next-generation games built on a clear division of labor. The GameWM-engine keeps what must be exact: rules, state, camera, and the layout of the world, which also spares the video model from having to remember it. The GameWM-VM generates what is expensive to author by hand: the look of the world and the detail of the player's interactions. One game mechanic can then be realized in many visually and physically distinct ways, while its outcome stays exactly as the engine computed it. To realize this division of labor, we build GameWM as a complete system: a data engine centered on interactions rather than exploration, an interface through which authored character sheets, scene art, and skill descriptions enter the model, and a model family from 5B to 33B parameters with a real-time causal variant for play. Together they give every player a fresh version of the same game: each player's own character, world, and skills turn the same engine mechanics into a new experience, while every event keeps the timing and outcome the GameWM-engine computed.
